title: The Sealed Letter
offer: Agent — a letter came addressed to the whole village. Bears the Council's crest. Commands every villager to open the East Gate at dusk "for a grain delivery." The Council swears they wrote no such thing. Someone is putting words in their mouth — and if the villagers obey, the Saboteur walks straight in. We must prove this letter false, and make sure no false letter ever passes again.
nextHint: Talk to Bram in the Village Square
debrief: Secure a message four ways: prove the sender, prove it's unchanged, hide it from strangers, and bind the sender to it.

steps.objective: Investigate the forged letter with Bram
